newsitem.title: GERMANY: World War Two bomb defused near Berlin.
newsitem.headline: World War Two bomb defused near Berlin.

text.p: Police on Thursday defused a World War Two bomb discovered lying beneath a densely-populated part of Oranienburg city centre, near Berlin.
Around 8,000 people had to evacuate their homes and offices to allow a police unit to defuse the 500kg (1,000 pound) bomb which had been lying about seven metres (20 feet) underground.
Police said the bomb was discovered by aerial photographs taken as part of a routine programme to find unexploded bombs left over from British and U.S. air raids on Germany during World War Two.
